Name: Short Hair Emily
Author: mistyspring
Description:
So i saw [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Emily#Timeline]this image in the wiki[/url] and i realized, Emily looked super cute with short hair. It's charming, isn't it? So i made a ContentPatcher version.

There's two options: with makeup, and without any. You can also choose if to patch the overworld sprite (or to leave it as- is- it's [b][i]optional![/i][/b]).

Manifest.Name: Emily
Manifest.Description: Gives Emily shorter hair, like one of her development versions.
Manifest.Author: mistyspring
